title: Phylogenetic tree demonstrating the relationship between the mitochondrial cytochrome b in Polychromophilus melanipherus and haemoplasma infections not associated with clinical signs in southern bent-winged bats (Miniopterus orianae bassanii) and eastern bent-winged bats (Miniopterus orianae oceanensis)
author: Holz, Peter H.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Run MrBayes phylogenetic analysis
steps.instruction: Execute MrBayes version 3.2.6 on the prepared cytochrome b alignment using four heated chains, a total chain length of 1,000,000 generations, sampling every 1,000 iterations, and discarding the first 10 % as burn‑in; apply the General Time Reversible (GTR) model with gamma‑distributed rate variation across sites, then generate the phylogenetic tree with branch support values shown as posterior probabilities and annotate each tip with its GenBank accession number.

substeps.instruction: Set up MrBayes v3.2.6 with four heated chains.
Specify a chain length of 1,000,000 generations.
Define a burn‑in of 10 % of the sampled trees.
Select the General Time Reversible (GTR) substitution model with gamma‑distributed rate variation across sites.
Run the analysis to produce the tree.
Record branch support values as posterior probabilities.
Add GenBank accession numbers to the corresponding taxa in the tree.
